comment: The thirteen docker pages fold into one Layouts and dockers page. The sidebar lists Layouts and dockers under Workspace and the Top Menu Bar and no docker. The page draws the layouts, Every docker's two switches and the two summon rows once, then one line per docker with Elements… and Options… where the docker has options. Elements… on the Colour Picker's line opens its list under its title with Layouts and dockers still marked, Back returns to the line, Options… on the Toolbox's line opens its options alone, a step that still names the Toolbox's old page gets its list and is told the options are behind Options…, and the ALT double click on the Layers docker's drag bar lands on the Layers line, marked. Each layout_rows step reads the open page's buttons and rows with their centres and says when one is outside the pane.
